title: Tate McRae Can't Be Contained in Lavish New 'Housewife' Video | United States
text:
Tate McRae bulldozes over stereotypes on her latest song, 'Housewife.'
The video for the new track sees the pop singer strut and dance across her mansion, yacht, and various lavish landscapes as she declares, “I just wanna make a lot of money, be my own housewife/You could be the one I’m calling honey/Be my sex on the side.
” At one point, she pushes a baby carriage filled with cash.the single.
“I’m so excited. I haven’t released in a while, and it’s kind of about a woman who can’t be contained,” McRae said.
“We shot it in the south of France, and it was so magical and so fun. ”“My fans in particular, we drop easter eggs all the time and they get none of them,” McRae replied.
“They’ll always catch on to things that are completely wrong. They’ll be like, ‘She wore sunglasses, so her next single’s called ‘Sunglass! ’ Like, what? They never get the most obvious easter eggs.
”set in Chicago back in August, saying that the word “Housewife” appeared during her performance on stage.
“This was literally in my Lolla set! It said, ‘Housewife’ when the set started,” she said.
